result.content:
# Proposed discovery plan

Determine whether to invest in developing a dedicated handoff tracker product specifically targeted at small software engineering teams in Latvia.

## Proposed scope

- Assessment of current handoff friction, status aggregation overhead, and workflow routines in small Latvian software teams.
- Evaluation of integration needs with common issue tracking and collaboration software.
- Exclusion of payroll, accounting, tax, or financial advisory functionality.

Region: Latvia

Explicit exclusions: Do not include payroll or financial advice

## Engineering Lead

Responsible for coordinating sprint transitions, handoff quality, and daily developer synchronizations within small engineering teams.

- How many hours per week does your team spend manually synthesizing and sharing status updates across handoffs? (question-0c4b4247416c0e132451fe31)
- Which tools currently handle your handoffs, and what critical handoff details are frequently lost or duplicated? (question-08cab71ed4d5355931375e44)

## Operations Manager

Oversees delivery cadence, operational workflows, and budget allocations for productivity software in small software organizations.

- What budget thresholds and procurement criteria govern software tooling purchases for internal team efficiency in your organization? (question-fab5db9e287434f78544fb21)
- Where do status update handoffs most frequently create cross-team misalignment or delayed deliverables? (question-f733c3df34b2e2bf83336c57)

## Simulation hypotheses

- We spend two hours copying handoff updates each Friday. [source:operator-interview]

## Assumptions

- Small software development teams in Latvia experience recurring manual overhead consolidating weekly progress and handoff updates.
- Teams may prefer an automated or dedicated handoff interface if it integrates frictionlessly with their primary communication tools.

## Evidence gaps

- Absence of verified empirical data on software tooling spend and handoff practices across tech companies in Latvia.
- No verified evidence confirming whether the Friday handoff copying burden observed in the synthetic fixture generalizes across Latvian software teams.
- No non-synthetic source findings were established; the plan is a proposal, not customer validation.

This scope is proposed, not a claim of user approval.

## Selected sources

- [source:operator-interview] Synthetic operator interview fixture — synthetic_transcript
